verses.en: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
verses.pt: De noite, em meu leito, busquei aquele a quem ama a minha alma; busquei-o, porém não o achei.
verses.en_web: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
verses.en_bbe: By night on my bed I was looking for him who is the love of my soul: I was looking for him, but I did not see him.

verses.en: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
verses.pt: Levantar-me-ei, pois, e rodearei a cidade; pelas ruas e pelas praças buscarei aquele a quem ama a minha alma. Busquei-o, porém não o achei.
verses.en_web: I will get up now, and go about the city; in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
verses.en_bbe: I will get up now and go about the town, in the streets and in the wide ways I will go after him who is the love of my soul: I went after him, but I did not see him.

verses.en: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said, Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?
verses.pt: Encontraram-me os guardas que rondavam pela cidade; eu lhes perguntei: Vistes, porventura, aquele a quem ama a minha alma?
verses.en_web: The watchmen who go about the city found me; “Have you seen him whom my soul loves?”
verses.en_bbe: The watchmen who go about the town came by me; to them I said, Have you seen him who is my heart's desire?

verses.en: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
verses.pt: Apenas me tinha apartado deles, quando achei aquele a quem ama a minha alma; detive-o, e não o deixei ir embora, até que o introduzi na casa de minha mãe, na câmara daquela que me concebeu:
verses.en_web: I had scarcely passed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, into the room of her who conceived me.
verses.en_bbe: I was but a little way from them, when I came face to face with him who is the love of my soul. I took him by the hands, and did not let him go, till I had taken him into my mother's house, and into the room of her who gave me birth.

verses.en: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
verses.pt: Conjuro-vos, ó filhos de Jerusalém, pelas gazelas e cervas do campo, que não acordeis, nem desperteis o amor, até que ele o queira.
verses.en_web: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
verses.en_bbe: I say to you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes of the field, let not love be moved till it is ready.

verses.en: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?
verses.pt: Que é isso que sobe do deserto, como colunas de fumaça, perfumado de mirra, de incenso, e de toda sorte de pós aromáticos do mercador?
verses.en_web: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all spices of the merchant?
verses.en_bbe: Who is this coming out of the waste places like pillars of smoke, perfumed with sweet spices, with all the spices of the trader?

verses.en: Behold his bed, which is Solomon’s; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel.
verses.pt: Eis que é a liteira de Salomão; estão ao redor dela sessenta valentes, dos valentes de Israel,
verses.en_web: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage! Sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: See, it is the bed of Solomon; sixty men of war are about it, of the army of Israel,

verses.en: They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.
verses.pt: todos armados de espadas, destros na guerra, cada um com a sua espada a cinta, por causa dos temores noturnos.
verses.en_web: They all handle the sword, and are expert in war. Every man has his sword on his thigh, because of fear in the night.
verses.en_bbe: All of them armed with swords, trained in war; every man has his sword at his side, because of fear in the night.

verses.en: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.
verses.pt: O rei Salomão fez para si um palanquim de madeira do Líbano.
verses.en_web: King Solomon made himself a carriage of the wood of Lebanon.
verses.en_bbe: King Solomon made himself a bed of the wood of Lebanon.

verses.en: He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved with love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Fez-lhe as colunas de prata, o estrado de ouro, o assento de púrpura, o interior carinhosamente revestido pelas filhas de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: He made its pillars of silver, its bottom of gold, its seat of purple, the middle of it being paved with love, from the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: He made its pillars of silver, its base of gold, its seat of purple, the middle of it of ebony.

verses.en: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.
verses.pt: Saí, ó filhas de Sião, e contemplai o rei Salomão com a coroa de que sua mãe o coroou no dia do seu desposório, no dia do júbilo do seu coração.
verses.en_web: Go out, you daughters of Zion, and see king Solomon, with the crown with which his mother has crowned him, in the day of his weddings, in the day of the gladness of his heart.
verses.en_bbe: Go out, O daughters of Jerusalem, and see King Solomon, with the crown which his mother put on his head on the day when he was married, and on the day of the joy of his heart.
